title: integral recurrence and density barrier for the sole j=1 E gate
proved: The actual E_h^* sequence in each nonzero residue class modulo 3 satisfies a primitive integral order-3 step-3 recurrence with four degree-22 coefficients Q_k.
The Q_k are derived symbolically from Item237's recurrence and Item243's gauge; they are not reconstructed from values.
The common polynomial gcd of Q_0,Q_1,Q_2,Q_3 is 1; their individual contents are (4096,512,4,27), with joint gcd 1.
For every h>=1, Q_0,Q_1,Q_2 are negative and Q_3 is positive.
Exact sign propagation gives E_h^*<0 for h=1 mod 3 and E_h^*>0 for h=2 mod 3.
After removing all prime-power factors at primes <=4h+3, N_E(h) has the same remaining part M_h as numerator(c_h), where c_h=[x^(2h)]C(x) for Item237's fixed algebraic series.
Algebraic denominator and analytic coefficient bounds give log rad(M_h)=O(h) and the generic collective bound O(H^2).

The comparison sequence a_h=4h+9 proves that rational/algebraic generation, fixed-order integral holonomy, integrality, and exponential height alone do not imply horizontal tied-prime mass o(H); every prime value automatically has admissible 3-nondivisible h.
The PNT-in-AP normalization for the comparison is theta(4H+9;4,1)+O(1)~2H.
exact_structural_obstructions: Q_3 contains 4h+39, which equals the actual row prime on s=6; (h,s,p)=(1,6,43) is a genuine admissible prime-row witness, so no uniform moving-prime forward-unit claim is possible from this operator.
Operator primitivity is not a value-gcd or radical theorem.
The threshold-dependent large-prime extraction M_h is nonlinear; no linear recurrence for M_h is claimed.
